correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 and c>=0 the quotient/remainder splitting after e low bits gives the residual F_{a,b}(n)=s_2(n+a)+b mod m. Distinct a are distinguishable using n=2^h-a_big and variation of h mod m. Enumerating reachable phases by full popcount intervals above and below c mod 2^e yields exactly Q_{m,c}; for c=2^k the distinct quotient levels give m+sum_{j=1}^{k+1}min(m,j). The transition recovers correct zero-padding outputs. Infinite proof is constructive; finite checks corroborate only a bounded set.
